doctor.headline: playable, 4 warnings
findings: The Upper Floor room 1 is the only room inside The Upper Floor and still carries its placeholder name, but it is not the exact shape a fold may undo (The Upper Floor is a floor), so the player stands in the placeholder rather than in The Upper Floor

The Bottom Floor room 1 is the only room inside The Bottom Floor and still carries its placeholder name, but it is not the exact shape a fold may undo (The Bottom Floor is a floor), so the player stands in the placeholder rather than in The Bottom Floor
this story has no arc, so no playthrough of it can ever reach an ending: there is no quest for a beat to belong to and no outcome to select. A world file's `quests:` block is where one is written
"The Landing" has no layout: nobody can be given a spot in it, so what is within reach there cannot be measured
